title: Embeddable voice widget keeps the mobile conversation visible and isolates inline sign-in credentials
steps: Run the real route and browser fixture tests from this branch. The fixture serves the widget assets and supplies synthetic speech and API responses; it sends no mail and creates no customer sites.
expect: Operator switch off and foreign-origin writes are refused.
OTP is verified for the bound email, excluded from history, and choices are retained.
Google requires a freshly attested OAuth callback and a single-use flow.
Mobile transcript scrolling, catalogue browsing and viewport resize keep the orb/composer visible.
Spoken email is read back before confirmation; OTP verifies on the same microphone and normal conversation resumes.
The visitor cookie is host-only and partitioned; sign-out clears the same path and partition.
The website widget is hidden by default until the operator enables its switch.
Every registered widget route appears in the API reference, with no documented route missing from the app.
A backend renewal of the internal guest session never sets that credential in the visitor browser.
fence: Operator/Origin gates, email binding, OAuth callback attestation, private speech cursor and persistent microphone; browser fixture does not replace the product JavaScript.

tests: widget is disabled by the operator switch and foreign writes are refused
OTP is bound to the submitted email, never reaches conversation, and keeps selections
Google completion authenticates the original embedded visitor and cannot be replayed
widget receives a fresh OAuth session only after the provider and both state checks succeeded
a shared speech session does not carry email or OTP chunks into resumed chat
mobile voice keeps the orb and composer visible while scrolling, browsing and resizing
voice sign-in confirms the spoken email and verifies OTP without replacing the microphone
widget visitor uses a host-only partitioned cookie and sign-out clears the matching scope
<html> carries the hidden ids at once (defaults), then the door answer
every route the app serves is in the reference, and every documented route is served
guest backend relays never set the internal session cookie in the browser
